title: Anna was the best guide...
text: Anna was the best guide ever for this tour. She is vegan and has found interesting places for this tour. The pace was excellent and food selections delicious!
author: Leah_T

title: A Vegan Must-Do
text:
We absolutely enjoyed this tour. Our lovely guide Ana took us to some amazing places for vegan bites & sightseeing, some of which we wouldn’t have discovered on our own. Because of the large portions, we were able to have the leftovers for dinner. 
Ana was the perfect guide- friendly, knowledgeable, and very accommodating. Highly recommend!
author: Pamela_W

title: A food tour and so much more
text: Not only is this a food exploration, our guide provided history and culture insights that brought the city to us in a more complete and  enjoyable way.

title: A perfect vegan culinary experience!!
text: Wow, I couldn't have asked for a better experience. It was beyond expectations! The food was so delicious, the culture, the views, truly an experience! title: Tasty vegan tour
text: I had an incredible time on the vegan food tour! The variety of delicious vegan dishes, from fresh tapas to decadent desserts was amazing. It was eye-opening to see just how much great plant-based food Barcelona has to offer. Plus, learning about the city’s history along the way made the experience even better. Highly recommend this tour for anyone curious about vegan cuisine!
author: batelm2022

title: vegan food tour in barcelona
text: The vegan food tour with anavegana in Barcelona was so tastey. the variety of the dishes were amazing, from fresh tapas to decadent desserts, so so delicious. Highly recommend next time youre in barcelona.

title: An amazing culinary adventure
